questions.question: K, L, M, N, O and P are six friends sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre. M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of K. K is sitting to the immediate right of N. L is sitting to the immediate left of N. P is sitting between L and O. Who is sitting to the immediate right of P?
questions.solution:
Given: K, L, M, N, O and P are six friends sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) M is sitting to the immediate left of O and immediate right of K.

2) K is sitting to the immediate right of N.

3) L is sitting to the immediate left of N.

4) P is sitting between L and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71e541dbe0f65bbc0b3bff3f113f9f4433f22a70e25eb191e391c811eba11be3.png] 

Here, 'L' is sitting to the immediate right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

441 ∶ 7 ∶∶ 225 ∶ 5 ∶∶ 729 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (√1st number) **÷** **3** = 2nd number.

Now,

For 441 ∶ 7

→ (√441) ÷ 3

→ 21 ÷ 3 = 7.

For 225 ∶ 5

→ (√225) ÷ 3

→ 15 ÷ 3 = 5.

Similarly, for **729 ∶ ?**

**→ (√729) ÷ 3**

**→ 27 ÷ 3 = 9.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.solution:

Here, "N" is sitting at the centre of the row.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cats are dogs.

Some dogs are elephants

All elephants are camels.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cats are elephants.

II. Some cats are elephants.

III. Some elephants are dogs

IV. Some camels are dogs.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All cats are dogs.

Some dogs are elephants

All elephants are camels.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f97bdb39763f91373df97444b0bdd6ea0150e95ae2a2f520e4d77274712a136c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cats are elephants - False (Because, No definite relation given between cats and elephant, so it can be possible only).

II. Some cats are elephants - False (Because, No definite relation given between cats and elephant, so it can be possible only).

III. Some elephants are dogs - True (Because, Some dogs are elephants, it means Some elephants are dogs)

IV. Some camels are dogs - True (Because, Those part of camel that is elephant will also dogs)

So, Conclusion III and IV follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
